play.quickExit3dsCrypto: Azahar detects this game as encrypted and refuses to launch it, no matter which keys you supply (it has blocked all encrypted content outside the eShop/System Settings since late 2024). The file is probably not actually decrypted despite its name: dump your own cartridge (GodMode9), or reinstall from a .cia redownloaded from the eShop.
play.quickExitVitaminDump: Vita3K refuses this file: it's a Vitamin-format dump, an old tool known to corrupt saves and break games, which the emulator blocks outright. Re-dump the game in NoNpDrm format.
